headline: नेशनल जूलॉजिकल पार्क ने दिल्ली चिड़ियाघर में दूसरा 'ट्री वॉक' और 11वां 'संडे बर्ड वॉक' आयोजित किया गया
राष्ट्रीय सफाई कर्मचारी आयोग (एनसीएसके) ने अपना 33वां स्थापना दिवस मनाया; इस कार्यक्रम में 900 से अधिक सफाई कर्मचारियों और अन्य हितधारकों ने हिस्सा लिया
Treaty of Córdoba
summary: The Treaty of Córdoba is signed in Córdoba, now in Veracruz, Mexico, concluding the Mexican War of Independence from Spain.

headline: American Revolutionary War
summary: American Revolutionary War: A small force of Pennsylvania militia is ambushed and overwhelmed by an American Indian group, which forces George Rogers Clark to abandon his attempt to attack Detroit.
imageAttribution: John Trumbull (Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons)

headline: Job Charnock
summary: Job Charnock of the East India Company establishes a factory in Calcutta, an event formerly considered the founding of the city (in 2003 the Calcutta High Court ruled that the city's foundation date is unknown).

headline: Surat
summary: The first official English representative to India lands in Surat.
